ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a curve graph of concentration changing with time, with the vertical axis as Concentration (M), the horizontal axis as Time (s), marked with about 30, 60, 90 s. Curves I and II rise from near 0 and then become flat; curve III has the highest initial concentration, decreases with time, and has already basically become a horizontal line when approaching t = 60 s. Reasoning: The container was initially evacuated, and only NO2 was placed in it, so the curve with a higher concentration at the beginning and then decreasing with decomposition should represent NO2, that is, curve III. The forward reaction is 2NO2(g) -> 2NO(g) + O2(g), and its rate depends on the concentration of the reactant NO2. In the figure, at t = 60 s, curve III has already become flat, indicating that the NO2 concentration no longer changes. Therefore, the forward reaction rate remains unchanged at t = 60 s.

raw_record.question_text:
$NO_2$ gas is placed in a sealed, evacuated container and allowed to decompose via the following equation:
$2NO_2(g) \leftrightarrow 2NO(g) + O_2(g)$
The graph below indicates the change in concentration for each species over time. Based on the graph, what is happening to the rate of the forward reaction at $t = 60$ s?

method.method_draft: First identify the forward-reactant curve from the graph: NO2 is initially present in the sealed evacuated container, so its concentration starts high and decreases; this corresponds to the decreasing curve III. Then look at t = 60 s on the graph and note that curve III is flat there. Because the forward rate depends on [NO2], and [NO2] is constant at that time, conclude that the forward reaction rate is remaining constant.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是浓度随时间变化的曲线图，纵轴为 Concentration (M)，横轴为 Time (s)，标有约 30、60、90 s。曲线 I 和 II 从接近 0 开始上升，随后变平；曲线 III 起始浓度最高，随时间下降，并在接近 t = 60 s 时已经基本变成水平线。

推理：容器最初是抽空的，并且只放入 NO2，因此一开始浓度较高、随后随分解而降低的曲线应代表 NO2，也就是曲线 III。正反应是 2NO2(g) -> 2NO(g) + O2(g)，其速率取决于反应物 NO2 的浓度。图中在 t = 60 s 时，曲线 III 已经变平，说明 NO2 浓度不再变化。因此，正反应速率在 t = 60 s 时保持不变。

method.method_draft: Inspect the graph around t = 60 s and note that the concentrations of NO2, NO, and O2 are all horizontal rather than rising or falling. Interpret this as the system having reached dynamic equilibrium. At dynamic equilibrium, forward and reverse reactions continue but at constant equal rates, so the forward reaction rate at 60 s is remaining constant.
